newsitem.title: USA: Amarillo feeder cattle prices steady-up $2 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Amarillo feeder cattle prices steady-up $2 - USDA.

text.p: Limited test feeder steers were steady and heifers steady to $2.00 per cwt higher, compared to last week, USDA said.
Bulk supply Medium and Large 1-2 300-800 lb feeder steers and 300-700 lb heifers. Trade moderate. Demand fairly good.
Feeder steers and heifers under lbs 82 percent, over 600 lbs 16 percent with cows and bulls around two percent of total supply.
Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 - 700-800 lbs 70.00-70.50; small lot 835 lbs 68.25. Medium and Large 1-2 - 600-700 lbs 67.00-72.50; few 700-800 lbs 64.50-66.50.

Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 - few 600-700 lbs 70.00-70.25; few 710-810 lbs 65.35-68.75. Medium and Large 1-2 - 500-700 lbs 62.50- 68.00; small lot 647 lbs 64.00. Small and Medium 1-2 - 300-500 lbs 70.00-77.00.
